martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, cycling looks great today, especially between 06:00–08:00 when it's a pleasant 23°C with calm winds. You might want to drag Britt along for a ride before it gets too warm. The rest of the day isn't bad either, but it's definitely more enjoyable in the morning.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, Saturday morning is looking perfect for a cycle — grab your bike and hit the road between 06:00–08:00 when it's calm and a nice 23°C. Moderate gusts pick up later, so make the most of the early hours. If Martha's free, drag her along for a relaxing ride, and maybe a drink on the terrace afterwards to cap it off.
